title: Spontaneous vs Responsive Desire
summary: Spontaneous desire appears out of the blue; responsive desire shows up only after touch, closeness or arousal has already started. Both are normal ways desire works.
key_points: Many people, especially in long relationships, mostly experience responsive desire.
Not 'feeling in the mood' first doesn't mean something is wrong.
